summary.text: George Khalaf is the Republican candidate for the Arizona House of Representatives, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A marketing and political-data consultant who advanced from the Republican primary on July 21, 2026, he says he is a Scottsdale resident and the founder of the research firm Data Orbital.

paragraphs.text: Khalaf graduated from Dobson High School and, according to his Ballotpedia survey response, from Arizona State University.

In the survey he described a professional background in political data, consulting and education-freedom advocacy, and said he is managing partner of The Resolute Group, founder of the data and survey research firm Data Orbital, and co-founder of the public relations firm First Day.
He said he is married, has three sons, and lives in Scottsdale with his family.
Khalaf advanced from a Republican primary on July 21, 2026, that also included incumbent Cody Reim, and will appear on the general election ballot for the two-seat district.
In the survey, he listed making communities safe, beginning with border security and support for law enforcement, among his key campaign messages.
